payload.body: You tend to notice the moment when a direct response could prevent a larger conflict. You question the charge, return the unwanted assignment, or say that the plan does not work for you before agreeing to it. You may still pause because action once felt safer after someone else made the first move. Use the opening to give a clear answer before the plan is already underway.
payload.astroHint: Lilith sextile Mars can give you practical openings to act on a boundary while the problem is still manageable.
